title: A row with a value says its target without a unit ("Optimal <1.4 · Aug 2026"), while its value page says "Optimal: <1.4 mmol/L"
evidence: Left after H83 (PR 1716, replacing PR 1710): a row with no value now shows its target with its unit (rowTarget's alone, "Optimal <1.4 mmol/L"), so the Add rows are fixed. A row with a value keeps the unitless bare target, because its unit is printed under the value (US-62 AC8/AC9); the open question is only whether that is enough. Adding the unit there wraps at 375px in SI, measured in real WebKit in PR 1710 (iPhone 13 profile): "Target <120/80 mmHg · Aug 2026", "Optimal <1.4 mmol/L · Aug 2026", "Normal <39 mmol/mol · Aug 2026", "Optimal <135 mg/dL · Aug 2026", "Optimal >1.0/>1.3 mmol/L · Aug 2026", "Normal 60–110/45–90 µmol/L · Aug 2026" and "Normal 0.7–1.2/0.5–1.0 mg/dL · Aug 2026" each take two lines; only US HbA1c "Normal <5.7% · Aug 2026" fits. (H103)
